svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: (32,128) fp16 with 128 B swizzle: two boxes of 8-row × 128 B atoms
inner box dim ≤ swizzle size (128 B) → 64 fp16 per box
each horizontal band = one 8-row atom (1 KB)
one atom: chunk k of row r sits in slot k XOR r
Reading k0 down 8 rows (a column of vectors) hits 8 different
slots = all 32 banks: conflict-free. Slot = 16 B = 8 fp16.
Swizzle<3,4,3> on byte addresses (= <3,3,3> on fp16 offsets).
